label: Treasure Hunter
tooltip: Coffer lines on the map and Treasure Hunt routes.

draw_line_to_bronze_chests.label: Lines to bronze coffers
draw_line_to_bronze_chests.tooltip: While out of combat, draw a brown line from you to nearby bronze coffers.

draw_line_to_silver_chests.label: Lines to silver coffers
draw_line_to_silver_chests.tooltip: While out of combat, draw a silver line from you to nearby silver coffers.

draw_line_to_carrots.label: Lines to carrots
draw_line_to_carrots.tooltip: While out of combat, draw a green line from you to nearby carrots.

show_percentage_active_treasure_count.label: Show remaining coffers as %
show_percentage_active_treasure_count.tooltip: Show how many coffers are left as a percentage next to the total.

return_to_base_camp_after_hunt.label: Return after hunt
return_to_base_camp_after_hunt.tooltip: Cast Return to base camp after Treasure Hunt finishes the last coffer, or after Carrot Hunt finishes its route.

play_sound_on_hunt_complete.label: Play sound when Treasure Hunt finishes
play_sound_on_hunt_complete.tooltip: Play an MP3 when Treasure Hunt finishes (Carrot Hunt does not use this).

hunt_complete_sound.label: Hunt finished sound
hunt_complete_sound.tooltip: Pick an MP3 from the plugin Sounds folder. Click a name to preview it.
hunt_complete_sound.open_folder: Open sound folder — drop MP3s here to add your own.

cast_treasure_sight_during_hunt.label: Cast Treasure Sight during hunt
cast_treasure_sight_during_hunt.tooltip: Cast Treasure Sight when the hunt starts, and again every N coffers. Stops the hunt early if Sight says no coffers are left.

treasure_sight_every_n_locations.label: Treasure Sight every N coffers
treasure_sight_every_n_locations.tooltip: After the first cast, cast Treasure Sight again every this many coffers. Raise it to dismount and swap jobs less often in busy areas.

hunt_max_level.label: Max coffer level
hunt_max_level.tooltip: Skip coffers above this level on the hunt route.

skip_unsafe_treasure_windows.label: Skip dangerous weather / Ashkin
skip_unsafe_treasure_windows.tooltip: Pause Treasure Hunt on South Horn during Ashkin or other unsafe weather windows.

enable_automatic_treasure_hunt_during_il.label: Auto treasure hunt in Illegal Mode
enable_automatic_treasure_hunt_during_il.tooltip: After a CE or FATE in Illegal Mode or Completionist (and after Triage Mode, if it ran): Return to camp and use Treasure Sight when you know it. Then start a treasure hunt if coffers remain — or hunt from the built-in map if you do not have Treasure Sight yet.

use_ninja_hide_on_dangerous_routes.label: Ninja Hide near strong enemies
use_ninja_hide_on_dangerous_routes.tooltip: Experimental: if a high-Knowledge enemy is nearby, swap to your Ninja gearset, use Hide, and walk the last stretch to the coffer. Useful near max Knowledge.

ninja_gearset_number.label: Ninja gearset number
ninja_gearset_number.tooltip: Gearset number that equips Ninja (as shown in the gearset list, starting at 1). 0 = do not swap — you must already be on Ninja.

knowledge_hide_offset.label: Hide when Knowledge is this much higher
knowledge_hide_offset.tooltip: Use Hide when a nearby enemy's Knowledge is at least your current (synced) Knowledge plus this number. 0 = same Knowledge or higher. On South Horn you are synced to Knowledge 20 even if your real Knowledge is higher — so mid-20s enemies can still trigger Hide there.

knowledge_threat_enter_distance.label: Start Hide within (yalms)
knowledge_threat_enter_distance.tooltip: Begin the Hide flow when a dangerous enemy is this close.

knowledge_threat_exit_distance.label: Keep Hide until farther than (yalms)
knowledge_threat_exit_distance.tooltip: Once Hide is on, keep it until enemies are farther than this. Use a larger value than “Start Hide” so it does not flicker on and off.
